title: Embedded Firmware Engineer-(Telematics)
description: Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Embedded Firmware Engineer with 4 to 5 years of experience to design, develop, and maintain software for our next-generation vehicle telematics control units (TCUs). In this role, your primary focus will be writing robust, production-grade firmware in Embedded C for resource-constrained ARM microcontrollers and Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS). Additionally, because our ecosystem includes advanced platforms running Linux and Embedded C++, exposure to high-level operating systems and object-oriented embedded design is a significant advantage. You will bridge the gap between automotive vehicle networks (CAN/CAN-FD) and cloud ecosystems via secure IoT messaging protocols. Core Responsibilities ● Firmware Development & Lifecycle: Design and implement high-performance, secure firmware using Embedded C for ARM microcontrollers, ensuring structural architecture patterns for reliable, fail-safe Over-the-Air (OTA) software update mechanisms. ● Automotive Networking & Diagnostics: Develop firmware to interface with vehicle networks using CAN, CAN-FD, and UDS (Unified Diagnostics Services) protocols to extract telemetry and structure basic on-board diagnostics. ● IoT & Cloud Connectivity: Implement secure edge-to-cloud communication utilizing MQTT and HTTPS protocols, managing secure data streaming, TLS encryption, and device identity profiling. ● RTOS & System Integration: Develop software on Real-Time Operating Systems (Zephyr OS), ensuring optimal memory management, deterministic multitasking, and low-power operations. ● Testing & Debugging: Use hardware debugging tools (JTAG, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes) and CAN analysis tools to isolate, reproduce, and resolve firmware and communication issues. Required Skills & Experience (Must Have) ● Experience: 4 to 5 years of hands-on experience in embedded systems firmware development, specifically working on vehicle telematics control units (TCUs) or connected vehicle hardware. ● Programming: Mastery of Embedded C for microcontrollers/microprocessors. Strong problem-solving skills in bare-metal and RTOS environments. ● Automotive Protocols: Direct experience writing firmware for CAN, CAN-FD, and basic UDS stack configurations. ● RTOS Frameworks: Proven experience developing for Real-Time Operating Systems, with a strong preference for Zephyr RTOS. ● Connectivity & Execution: Practical exposure to IoT edge network connectivity configurations (MQTT, HTTPS, TLS security) alongside building robust firmware boot flow flash handling for OTA execution. ● Cloud Clients: Familiarity with cloud IoT SDKs, such as the AWS IoT Core Client or Azure IoT Hub Client. Preferred & Plus Qualifications (Highly Valued) ● Remote Diagnostics (Plus): Hands-on experience architecting remote vehicle diagnostics frameworks, incorporating deep UDS service structures (e.g., custom Data Identifiers [DIDs], Routine Control, and SecurityAccess/Authentication seed-key exchanges over the air). ● C++ & Linux Foundations: Practical familiarity with Embedded C++ and core conceptual knowledge of Linux/POSIX system levels or Android frameworks. ● Linux Environment Tools: Comfort utilizing Linux Bash command-line utilities and understanding foundational bootloader workflows (e.g., uBoot). ● Advanced Embedded OS: Exposure to custom Linux image creation via Yocto Linux or basic Linux kernel module modification. Work Environment & Employment Details ● Experience Level: Mid-Senior (4–5 Years) ● Work Setup: 100% On-Site position Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year Benefits: Flexible schedule Health insurance Internet reimbursement Leave encashment Life insurance Paid time off Provident Fund Work Location: In person
